loud-distorted-playback.note: Volume normalization was a no-op. Fixed in v2.3.8. plasticator2 confirmed resolved (#178). Root cause was also +20dB 'Default Adjustment for Remote Streams' setting.

docker-mdns-port-conflict.note: tontze: TrueNAS Docker, port 5353 EADDRINUSE blocks mDNS discovery. Workaround from TROUBLESHOOTING applied successfully. Now blocked by Keymaster 403 (new account cohort, tracked in #91).

new-account-no-stored-credentials.note: Audio key denial is per-account cohort. PKCE fixes Browse/Search/Library and playback for mid-cohort accounts (woorszt confirmed). Newest-cohort accounts (Chezza, tontze) remain blocked at audio key layer — no client-side workaround.

windows-token-capture-broken.note: Proc::Background stdout redirect fails on Windows services. Token JSON lost, Browse/Library broken. Present since v2.3.2, fixed in v2.3.11 via SPOTON_TOKEN_FILE env var. Awaiting foxesden confirmation.

loud-distorted-resolved.note: plasticator2 confirmed v2.3.9 + normalization fix resolved distortion. Root cause was +20dB 'Default Adjustment for Remote Streams' on one player. CJS explained Spotty ignores that setting when ReplayGain enabled.

ogg-normalization-passthrough.note: trackGain() implemented in v2.3.12 — suppresses LMS Default Adjustment when SpotOn normalization active. GH #108. CJS confirmed fix in post #193.

mherger-ai-auth-comment.note: mherger comments on AI usage and confirms PlayPlay/auth issues affect Spotty equally. No action needed.

playplay-account-age-confirmation.note: mccauls confirms: new premium trial fails, old free->premium works. Account creation date is the criterion, not premium status.

cjs-v3-pkce-setup.note: CJS self-resolved: v3.0.3 PKCE setup works after configuring Redirect URI and Client ID. Screenshot of Developer App settings provided as example.

cjs-empty-playlist-pathfinder-hash.note: CJS confirmed v3.1.1 fix works (post #216). Playlist schema normalization fixed it. Client ID question answered in reply #216.

dstm-autoplay-override.note: SpotOn Autoplay overrides DSTM Disabled setting. CJS provided workaround. GH #117 tracks the UX fix.

auth-architecture-discussion.note: Multi-post architecture discussion. v3.0 shipped (PKCE replaces Keymaster). v3.1.0 shipped (bundled Client ID fallback). Audio key denial affects newest-cohort accounts only — mid-cohort (woorszt) fully restored by PKCE.

ubuntu-browse-empty-pete7874.note: Pete7874: Browse/Library empty on Ubuntu + Squeezebox Touch, 6 players, old account recently upgraded to Premium. Diagnostic posted on GH #116 — daemon auth OK but crash-loop, likely Keymaster 403. Server.log + Status page requested.
